Abiding Word reads USFM Bibles (.usfm or .sfm files, or a .zip of them), the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible’s OSIS files and MorphGNT files. A Bible can also be added from PDF, EPUB, Word (.docx), Markdown or text documents.

bibleImport.verseMapApplied: This text uses the Hebrew Bible’s verse numbers. They were changed to the English numbering with the verse map supplied ({{moved}} verses renumbered, {{joined}} joined, {{titles}} Psalm titles kept as titles).

bibleImport.hebrewNumbering: This text seems to use the Hebrew Bible’s verse numbers (Joel has four chapters). Add the verse map that comes with it (for the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible: wlc/VerseMap.xml) to the files chosen, and they will be renumbered.
bibleImport.verseMapUnsplit: These Hebrew verses each hold parts of two English verses, and these files do not mark where one ends: {{places}}. Each is kept whole under its Hebrew number, so it also holds words of the neighbouring English verse, and that verse is incomplete or missing.
bibleImport.verseMapConflict: At {{places}} the text’s own verse mark and the verse map disagree; the text’s mark was followed.
bibleImport.psalmTitlesInVerse: Where the Hebrew text writes a Psalm’s title as the start of verse 1, these files do not mark where the title ends, so it stays part of verse 1.
bibleImport.verseMapDivided_one: {{count}} Hebrew verse was divided where the text itself marks the start of an English verse ({{titles}} of the parts are Psalm titles).
bibleImport.verseMapDivided_other: {{count}} Hebrew verses were divided where the text itself marks the start of an English verse ({{titles}} of the parts are Psalm titles).
bibleImport.documentAmbiguous: {{book}} {{chapter}}:{{verse}}: two places in the text could be where this verse begins.

bibleImport.documentLongVerse: {{book}} {{chapter}}:{{verse}} is far longer than any verse: the verses after it were not found.
bibleImport.documentChanged: “{{fileName}}” was changed after it was reviewed. Choose the files again.

bibleImport.documentNoBook_one: {{count}} verse number was found where no book name comes before it; it was left out.
bibleImport.documentNoBook_other: {{count}} verse numbers were found where no book name comes before them; they were left out.
bibleImport.documentUnnumbered_one: In {{count}} chapter verse 1 has no number of its own: the text between the chapter’s heading and verse 2 was taken as verse 1.

bibleImport.documentPsalmTitles_one: {{count}} Psalm title was kept as a title, before verse 1.
bibleImport.documentPsalmTitles_other: {{count}} Psalm titles were kept as titles, before verse 1.
